title: gmail
description: One Gmail mailbox through a connected account: search and read mail other people wrote, save a draft that reaches no one, send a mail once the operator confirms it — and the inbox as a channel: mail arrives by Google's push, is renewed and caught up on a schedule, and a contact is mailed without a card.

settings.title: Google account
settings.description: a Google account connected on the Plugins page with the gmail service (modify to draft and send); add pubsub and gmail.setup can make the Pub/Sub topic and subscription

settings.title: Pub/Sub topic
settings.description: the Pub/Sub topic Gmail publishes to, projects/<project>/topics/<topic>; gmail.setup creates it, or grant publish to gmail-api-push@system.gserviceaccount.com yourself

settings.title: Pub/Sub push service account
settings.description: the push service account's email: its OIDC token is what the host accepts. Make it once in the console; the Pub/Sub service agent needs Token Creator on it

settings.title: Sends allowed per window
settings.description: the most messages this channel sends in any one window — a bound on what a runaway identity can send; a send over it is refused, saying when the next can go

settings.title: Window, in minutes
settings.description: the length of the window the send limit is counted over
